topics.description: EventBridge Pipes enables point-to-point event integration between sources (SQS, DynamoDB Streams, Kinesis) and targets with optional filtering, enrichment, and transformation — a core serverless integration pattern.

gRPC is a high-performance RPC framework using Protocol Buffers and HTTP/2. Core concepts include service definitions, unary/server-streaming/client-streaming/bidirectional-streaming RPCs, deadlines, metadata, and authentication.

Node.js diagnostics covers production debugging, CPU profiling, heap analysis, memory leak detection, async trace debugging, and performance monitoring using built-in tools like inspector, trace events, and diagnostic reports.
